name: VRzomOL
summary:
The VRzomOl is a VRFPS game that focuses on PVP network online biochemical battle mode, an improvement from the original CS's popular biochemical mode. The game features two modes: zombie escape and biochemical infection. In these modes, online players must play as either humans or zombies. Within a limited time frame, humans must either annihilate all zombies or save themselves, while zombies aim to infect all humans through an all-out attack.
